logical_model.summary: Logical design for datamodel, derived from the conceptual model. 20 entities carry 23 relationships: 2 associative entities resolve many-to-many relationships and 1 entities are identified through a parent. 0 entities required a surrogate identifier because no business key was recorded. Attributes are typed against abstract domains and carry no platform-specific length, precision or storage.

subject_areas.name: Geography
subject_areas.description: Master data for countries, states, cities, and warehouse locations that serve as reference points across the enterprise.

subject_areas.name: Catalog
subject_areas.description: Product master data including categorization, suppliers, pricing, and promotional campaigns.

subject_areas.name: Sales
subject_areas.description: Customer master data, sales orders, order items, and sales representative management.

subject_areas.name: Fulfillment
subject_areas.description: Warehouse inventory management, order shipments, and product returns processing.

subject_areas.name: Finance
subject_areas.description: Payment processing and financial transaction recording for customer orders.

subject_areas.name: Organization
subject_areas.description: Employee master data, department structure, and management hierarchies.

subject_areas.name: Operations
subject_areas.description: System audit and operational logging of database changes.

entities.name: Audit Log
entities.description: System-generated record of all database operations (INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE) with timestamp and user information for compliance and troubleshooting.

entities.name: Category
entities.description: Product classification scheme that organizes the product catalog into logical groupings (e.g., Accessories, Storage).

entities.name: City
entities.description: City location record that belongs to a state, used for customer addresses and warehouse locations.

entities.name: Country
entities.description: Sovereign nation reference with ISO country code, serving as the top level of geographic hierarchy.

entities.name: Customer
entities.description: Individual or organization that places orders. Identified by a customer number and has a credit limit and active status.

entities.name: Department
entities.description: Organizational unit to which employees are assigned, representing teams or functions such as Finance or Support.

entities.name: Employee
entities.description: Person employed by the company who may be a sales representative, manager, or other operational role. Employees report to managers within a hierarchy.

entities.name: Inventory
entities.description: Stock position of a product at a specific warehouse, including current quantity on hand and reorder trigger level. This is a managed entity tracking supply.

entities.name: Order
entities.description: Customer purchase order placed on a specific date, assigned to a sales representative, with a fulfillment status (e.g., DELIVERED).

entities.name: Order Item
entities.description: Line item within an order specifying the product, quantity ordered, and unit price at time of sale.

entities.name: Payment
entities.description: Financial transaction recording customer payment against an order, including method (e.g., UPI), date, and amount.

entities.name: Product
entities.description: Saleable item in the catalog, identified by SKU, with a category, supplier, unit price, and active status.

entities.name: Product Promotion Association
entities.description: Resolves the many-to-many relationship between Product and Promotion. Each occurrence records that one Product references one Promotion.

entities.name: Product Warehouse Association
entities.description: Resolves the many-to-many relationship between Product and Warehouse. Each occurrence records that one Product references one Warehouse.

entities.name: Promotion
entities.description: Marketing campaign offering a discount percentage that can apply to one or more products.

entities.name: Return
entities.description: Record of a product being returned from an order, including the reason (e.g., Damaged).

entities.name: Shipment
entities.description: Outbound movement of order fulfillment from a warehouse, with tracking number and shipment date.

entities.name: State
entities.description: Geographic subdivision of a country, used to organize cities and define regional hierarchies.

entities.name: Supplier
entities.description: Vendor organization that supplies products to the company, with contact details.

entities.name: Warehouse
entities.description: Physical location where inventory is stored and orders are fulfilled, situated in a city.

normalization_actions.action: Resolved many-to-many between Product and Promotion
normalization_actions.rationale: A many-to-many relationship cannot be represented without a repeating group. An associative entity keyed on both parents removes the repetition and gives the relationship a place to carry its own attributes later.

normalization_actions.action: Resolved many-to-many between Product and Warehouse
normalization_actions.rationale: A many-to-many relationship cannot be represented without a repeating group. An associative entity keyed on both parents removes the repetition and gives the relationship a place to carry its own attributes later.

normalization_actions.action: Checked non-key attributes against the full composite key
normalization_actions.rationale: Audit Log has a composite key, so every non-key attribute (operation) must depend on the whole key rather than part of it. No partial dependency was found.

normalization_actions.action: Checked non-key attributes against the full composite key
normalization_actions.rationale: Inventory has a composite key, so every non-key attribute (quantity, reorder_level) must depend on the whole key rather than part of it. No partial dependency was found.

normalization_actions.action: Checked non-key attributes against the full composite key
normalization_actions.rationale: Order Item has a composite key, so every non-key attribute (quantity, unit_price) must depend on the whole key rather than part of it. No partial dependency was found.

normalization_actions.action: Identified Order Item as dependent on Order
normalization_actions.rationale: Its business key includes Order's key (order_id), so it cannot be identified independently. The relationship is identifying and the key is propagated rather than duplicated.

normalization_actions.action: Confirmed State attributes are not repeated on City
normalization_actions.rationale: City references State, which references Country. The chain is already decomposed, so Country's attributes reach City by navigation rather than by duplication.

normalization_actions.action: Confirmed City attributes are not repeated on Customer
normalization_actions.rationale: Customer references City, which references State. The chain is already decomposed, so State's attributes reach Customer by navigation rather than by duplication.

normalization_actions.action: Confirmed Warehouse attributes are not repeated on Inventory
normalization_actions.rationale: Inventory references Warehouse, which references City. The chain is already decomposed, so City's attributes reach Inventory by navigation rather than by duplication.

normalization_actions.action: Confirmed Employee attributes are not repeated on Order
normalization_actions.rationale: Order references Employee, which references Employee. The chain is already decomposed, so Employee's attributes reach Order by navigation rather than by duplication.

normalization_actions.action: Confirmed Product attributes are not repeated on Order Item
normalization_actions.rationale: Order Item references Product, which references Supplier. The chain is already decomposed, so Supplier's attributes reach Order Item by navigation rather than by duplication.

normalization_actions.action: Confirmed Order attributes are not repeated on Payment
normalization_actions.rationale: Payment references Order, which references Employee. The chain is already decomposed, so Employee's attributes reach Payment by navigation rather than by duplication.

normalization_actions.action: Confirmed Warehouse attributes are not repeated on Product Warehouse Association
normalization_actions.rationale: Product Warehouse Association references Warehouse, which references City. The chain is already decomposed, so City's attributes reach Product Warehouse Association by navigation rather than by duplication.

normalization_actions.action: Confirmed Product attributes are not repeated on Return
normalization_actions.rationale: Return references Product, which references Supplier. The chain is already decomposed, so Supplier's attributes reach Return by navigation rather than by duplication.

normalization_actions.action: Confirmed Warehouse attributes are not repeated on Shipment
normalization_actions.rationale: Shipment references Warehouse, which references City. The chain is already decomposed, so City's attributes reach Shipment by navigation rather than by duplication.

normalization_actions.action: Confirmed City attributes are not repeated on Warehouse
normalization_actions.rationale: Warehouse references City, which references State. The chain is already decomposed, so State's attributes reach Warehouse by navigation rather than by duplication.
